title: Roles & permissions
subtitle: See what each role can do, and create your own for a new kind of staff member.
emptyHelp: Something has gone wrong — the platform always has at least its built-in roles.
builtInExplain: This role's name and description are defined in code and cannot be changed here, but its permissions can be.
fullyLockedExplain: This role is fully protected — nothing about it, including its permissions, can be changed here.
staleConflict: This role was changed by someone else since you loaded it.
notGrantable: You don't hold this permission yourself, so you can't grant it.
confirmChangeDescription: This will change what {count} users can do.
deleteBlocked: Held by {count} users — move them to another role first.
